title: Fix Undo functionality and improve over-by-over reporting on Live Scoring screen

requirements.text: Add a visible and functional 'Undo last ball' button on the Live Scoring page that removes the most recently recorded ball from the current innings ball history and updates all displayed scoreboard values (runs, wickets, overs, balls) accordingly, with support for both local-only matches and backend-synced matches.
acceptanceCriteria: An 'Undo last ball' button is visible on the Live Scoring screen at all times during active scoring
Clicking 'Undo' removes the last recorded ball from the innings ball history
All scoreboard values (total runs, wickets, overs, balls, striker runs, non-striker runs, bowler stats) update immediately after undo
Undo works correctly for both local-only matches and backend-synced matches
The button is disabled when there are no balls to undo (innings ball history is empty)
User sees a success toast message after successfully undoing a ball

requirements.text: Fix the Live Scoring page state reload behavior so that navigating away to Match Stats (or any other page) and then returning to Live Scoring does not reset the striker and non-striker selections or require re-selecting batsmen, preserving the current batting state across navigation.

quotes: Still going to stats and coming back to match is asking to select the batsmen.

acceptanceCriteria: After navigating from Live Scoring to Match Stats and back, the striker and non-striker remain selected without requiring re-selection
The bowler selection is also preserved across navigation
All scoring controls (run buttons, wicket, extras) remain enabled and functional after returning
The ball history and scoreboard values remain accurate after navigation round-trip
No 'Please select striker and non-striker' blocking message appears when returning to a match that already has batters selected

requirements.text: Replace the existing 'Last Over' summary on the Live Scoring screen with a comprehensive over-by-over breakdown that displays runs scored in each individual completed over (1st over, 2nd over, 3rd over, etc.) throughout the current innings, not just the most recent over, so the scorer can see the full scoring progression.

quotes: Not able to view over by over report. Require 1st over how many runs scored and 2nd over like individual over data.

acceptanceCriteria: The Live Scoring screen displays a list/grid showing runs scored in each completed over (Over 1: X runs, Over 2: Y runs, etc.)
The breakdown updates immediately after each over is completed (6 legal deliveries)
The display shows overs in chronological order (1st, 2nd, 3rd...) so the scorer can see scoring progression
The component uses the existing computeOverByOverBreakdown utility to compute over data
The over-by-over breakdown is visible and scrollable on mobile screens without layout overflow

constraints: Do not modify backend/main.mo unless absolutely required for undo functionality
Preserve existing offline-first patterns for all match and ball operations
Do not break existing state persistence in localMatchStore
Ensure all changes work for both local-only matches and backend-synced matches
nonGoals: Adding redo functionality (only undo is requested)
Changing the visual theme or color scheme
Modifying toss information display or match summary layouts
Adding new statistics views beyond what already exists
